decision: Do HANH VI cua cache (doi file ngoai goi thi cache co be khong) thay vi soi danh sach inputs trong turbo.json

decision: Ngoai-1: mo hop dong moi — ban khai input cua bo ve ghim ten ho so nen se chet khi ho so ay doi di hoac bo ve doc them ho so khac; can mot chan suy danh sach file DOC THAT luc chay roi doi chieu voi ban khai
